meta.scope: Record S082 publisher-preview cohort while preserving unresolved model denominator and metric mapping

records.title: Pain intensity classification and evaluation of individual differences in subjects based on hybrid CNN–BiLSTM approach

decisions.notes: ScienceDirect indexed preview checked on 2026-09-28: §2.1 reports a cohort of 26 university students (16 male, 10 female, age 22-25). Published abstract reports four undivided-group class accuracies and 93.98% overall after sensitivity-group stratification under LOSOCV. Indexed Conclusions separately reports 91.79% four-level accuracy without an accessible setup label; the relation is unresolved. Complete result tables and model-analysis denominator remain unavailable. No external clinical validation.

searches.query: 10.1016/j.bspc.2026.109815 Participants cohort denominator and 91.79 versus 93.98 setup

updates.ограничения: The official ScienceDirect preview exposes §2.1 Participants (26 healthy university students) and the abstract, but not the Results tables or complete validation protocol. The model-analysis denominator, fold composition, class counts and exact relation of 91.79% in indexed Conclusions to 93.98% after sensitivity stratification remain unresolved. The arithmetic match of 91.79% to four undivided-group class accuracies is an inference only. Cold-pressor experimental pain does not establish chronic-pain clinical validity, ECAP, SCS response or treatment effect.

evidence.population: Twenty-six healthy university students aged 22-25 (16 male, 10 female) underwent cold-pressor EEG testing; the number included in each reported model comparison is not established from the accessible preview.
